_noteP: Mortal Will: a stacking resource (5 basic-attack/ability-cast stacks -> next basic ability empowered), no direct damage calc of its own. Its per-skill empowered bonuses (EmpoweredDamageCalc on Q, EmpoweredDamageMultCalcModified on W) are curated as bonusEffects attached to the slot whose BIN spell actually owns the calc (Q and W respectively), same convention as Nunu/Ornn/Qiyana cross-ability procs. Approximated trigger onAbility/onHit rather than modeling the exact 5-stack gate (conservative always-on approximation of a gated precondition, established convention).
_noteQ: Comet Spear: curated TapDamageCalc (the quick-release 'Thrust', TapDamage DataValue + 1.15x bonus AD) as the base hit -- matches wiki 'Thrust Physical Damage: 70/100/130/160/190 (+115% bonus AD)' exactly, and is the ability's default cast style per its own info box ('This ability always employs Quick cast'). HoldDamageCalc (the charged 'Hurl', same base + an extra 50% AP) is strictly >= Tap and situational (requires holding the cast), so Tap is used as the conservative floor. M25 §11.G VsLowHp conditional (loop 107): against a target below 20% max HP (BIN DataValue CritHealthThreshold = 0.20), Comet Spear deals its amplified value ExecuteDamageCalcModified = (HoldDamage + HoldExecuteDamage) + 2.3x bonus AD -- roughly 2x the Tap base (the AD ratio itself doubles 1.15->2.3), the archetype VsLowHp damage BONUS (an AMPLIFY, NOT a kill-line execute -- it must still exceed the target's effective HP to kill; §8.2 honesty guard forbids tagging it Execute, and the old 'Execute' slot tag is removed). Target current HP is NOT exposed by the Live Client API -> HpBelow is UserAssumed: calc:TapDamageCalc is the UNMET anchor (>20% = the prior conservative reading, value identity = zero regression), metCalc:ExecuteDamageCalcModified is the MET/low-HP end (RangeMax). The UserConditionMet knob defaults unmet; the exposure-graph spans [base, amplified]. Both calcs resolve from PantheonQ's own mSpellCalculations. Mortal Will bonusEffect: trigger onAbility, EmpoweredDamageCalc (ByCharLevelInterpolation 20-240 + 1.15x bonus AD), Physical, matching wiki 'Mortal Will: ... 20-240 (+115% bonus AD) bonus physical damage'.
